description: Defines a class ExceptionSerializationOptions used for configuring exception serialization behavior, including supported namespace prefixes and a filter predicate.

classes.name: ExceptionSerializationOptions
classes.description: Provides options for configuring exception serialization, including supported namespace prefixes and a predicate to determine serializability.

methods.name: SupportedNamespacePrefixes (getter)
methods.description: Returns the set of namespace prefixes supported for exception serialization.

methods.name: SupportedExceptionTypeFilter (getter/setter)
methods.description: Gets or sets the predicate function that determines if an exception type should be serialized.
